name: claude-code-metrics-sidecar
description: Receives Claude Code's native OTLP telemetry and re-emits it in NeuroLink proxy format (proxy_* metrics, proxy.request spans, neurolink_proxy request_final logs) so existing OpenObserve dashboards keep working.

scripts.test: node --test test/classify.test.mjs test/transform.test.mjs test/protobuf.test.mjs test/protobuf-encode.test.mjs test/usage.test.mjs test/e2e.test.mjs
